title: Night shift handoff — messy scratchpad (v0.3)
body:
PURPOSE:
Quick, messy handoff notes and temporary procedures for night shift cover — NOT final. Use at your discretion, check links and open tickets before wide circulation. Keep this as a live scratchpad; Ill tidy into the formal runbook next week.

SUMMARY (from midnight->08:00 shift):
- 00:10: Minor surge on hosted-api-us-west causing 5xx spike for ~12m. Root cause: recycled worker pool with old model artifact (v1.9-beta) still in S3 cache. Mitigated by warming pool and forcing model pull to v1.9-stable.
- 02:45: KV cache pressure on dedicated-pool-3 leading to CPU spikes on controller; autoscaler short-circuited due to bug (see JIRA-INVEST-879). Rolled back latest autoscaler rule and scaled pool manually.
- 05:20: Spurious slow tail latency (> 3s p99) for embeddings route region-eu. Traced to noisy nightly eval job (eval-run-2026-03-12) consuming GPUs on shared-dedicated; politely queued the job and re-prioritized inference queues.

IMMEDIATE ACTIONS (things I did / you can repeat):
- If hosted-api 5xx spike: check /metrics/error-rate and /logs/hosted/us-west. Quick fix: restart warmers for affected model groups. Command: kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/warmers-us-west-<model-group> (beware: restarting too many at once causes cascade).
- If autoscaler misbehaves: revert to rule v2026-02-22 (stable). CI pipeline: infra/terraform/autoscaler: run terraform apply -target=module.autoscaler.rule_v2026_02_22. If you dont have TF access, manual scale: aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name dedicated-pool-3 --desired-capacity 6.
- For noisy eval jobs: pause via internal scheduler UI (link in linked_artifacts) or send "pause-eval <job-id>" in #infra-jobs slack.

KNOWN TEMPORARY PROCEDURES (drafts):
1) Temp model-pinning during warm rollouts (proof-of-concept)
- When rolling models between minor versions (e.g., 1.9-beta -> 1.9-stable) pin warmers to stable for 10m before allowing beta traffic. Implementation: set annotation inference.warm/pinning=true on deployment. (TODO: formalize annotation docs + k8s operator change)
2) Safeguard for autoscaler pipeline
- If autoscaler plan contains more than 4 simultaneous instance changes, do a staged apply: stage-1 apply -> wait 3m -> stage-2 apply. (TEMP until JIRA-INVEST-879 is fixed)

CHECKLIST FOR HANDOFF (what I expect next person to do):
- Read "SUMMARY" above and scan dashboards: Hosted API error-rate (dashboard hosted/api-errors), Dedicated pool health (dedicated/pool-3), GPU utilization (sre/gpu-overview).
- Note any ongoing incidents in #oncall-incidents and annotate this doc with short bullet.
- If any incident is unresolved, escalate per matrix below and leave a Slack ping in #escalations with tag @oncall-lead.

ESCALATION MATRIX (quick):
- Sev2 (sustained >10% error-rate or p99 > 5s for 20+ min): page SRE lead (Diego), and infra eng (Priya). Use PagerDuty team: redwood-inference-sre.
- Sev1 (platform down for >5min or data loss): page CTO and oncall-corporate.

SHORT COMMANDS (copy/paste cheat-sheet):
- tail logs: gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND resource.labels.namespace_name=infra" --limit 200 --project=redwood-prod \/
- restart warmers: kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/warmers-us-west-transformers
- scale ASG: aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name $ASG --desired-capacity 6
- force model pull: kubectl -n inference delete pod -l app=model-puller --field-selector status.phase=Running

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs (notes to self and next shifter):
- Confirm whether model artifact GC is responsible for stale artifacts in S3 cache. Filing follow-up ticket: INFRA-ARTIFACT-GC-002 (Priya assigned).
- Decide if we should throttle nightly evals by default in regions with low spare capacity. (Next: proposal doc).
- Add sequence of safe rollback steps for model-serving operator to formal runbook. (I started a draft in Confluence: CONFLUENCE-1234)

INCIDENT TIMELINE (concise):
- 00:07 detection alert, 00:10 spike confirmed, 00:14 started model-puller restart, 00:21 error rate dropped to baseline. Postmortem notes: do not allow warmers to pull from beta tag without manual approval during canary windows.

PERSONAL NOTES (quick & messy):
- Watch out for cascade restarts — when restarting warmers try 2 at a time per AZ.
- If youre unsure: ping Diego, hes awake right now (I messaged him at 06:00).
- Keep this doc as ephemeral; once we have stable steps move into shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime/runbooks/model-warmers.json

REFERENCES / LINKS (quick):
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-1234 (model-warmers draft)
- Jira: JIRA-INVEST-879 (autoscaler bug), INFRA-ARTIFACT-GC-002 (artifact GC)
- GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412 (autoscaler partial fix)
- Slack threads: #oncall-incidents (today thread ts:1623456789), #infra-jobs

END-OF-SHIFT REMARKS:
- Leaving note in #oncall-logs with incident IDs and brief summary.
- If you take over, add your name+timestamp below and mark anything unresolved.

-- Samira (oncall, night shift) 2026-03-12 07:55Z

NEXT-HANDOFF-LOG: (fill in)
